requirements.name: dataset/source membership
requirements.selection: Read receipt /identities/datasetId, /datasetSha256 and /sourceInputsSha256; match exact dataset /datasetId and actual SHA of unique parent dataset/source-input files. All source entries must match current Git/inventory, not merely HEAD text.

requirements.name: forty historical gate refusals
requirements.selection: Resolve all forty dynamic command UUID keys in /historicalCommandWriteGateReasons, join each to exact input dataset /historicalCohorts command; every actual value contains SEALED_AUTHORIZATION_MISSING_OR_EXPIRED and AUTHORITY_PERMANENTLY_INVALIDATED. Emit concrete RFC6901 pointer after reading actual keys.

requirements.name: current untransmitted refusal
requirements.selection: Read /currentCommandWriteGateReasons and require GLOBAL_SWITCH_DISABLED. Use full actual typed array after review, not invented scalar or array index.

requirements.name: runtime resources
requirements.selection: Receipt /identities/runtimeResourceReceiptSha256 matches exact original outer resource member; retain /runtime (JVM) and /postgresContainerResources plus outer host and docker limits separately. Report actual values, never reuse historical CI4CPU or infer 0 container limit means 0 VM.

requirements: This is the same actual backend run and named test, only a separate declared layer attribution; never count it twice.
Diagnostic, dataset, receipt and source-inputs are all four mandatory exact parent members. Running/failed backend cannot supply admitted mixed layer even if an individual test completed.
For inequalities independently compare actual numeric value with required bound, then put actual typed value into exact raw-pointer adapter; never replace a measurement with its threshold.
Local publicationIdentity testedMerge/workflow fields may honestly be NOT_PROVIDED. Do not synthesize CI identity; CI jobs have separate actual receipt/dataset/resources.
Dataset is captured after setup history but before measured targeted/sweep workers. Do not claim its canonicalInputRows are final post-sweep state.

Synthetic historic readback/authorization/reservation are INPUT. Measured workers prove processing, mature/revised outcomes, late correction and containment/refusal. No command admission/APPLY throughput, no forty new authorization expiry events, no actual future waiting claim.

requirements.name: exact JAR and migration inventory
requirements.selection: /artifactSha256 equals exact successful full-backend JAR SHA. /migrationInventory equals source-pinned canonical migration byte inventory. backend-products-before and after retain same JAR/SBOM SHA. /logs includes actual wrong-digest and missing-properties refusal outputs checked by source verifier.
